text:
aris: :rotating_light: monitoring alerted — sudden spike in 429s from the rate-enforcer after the new ratefilter rollout at ~09:12 UTC. Affected: org=acme-corp, org=halo-inc. Observed across eu-west-1 and us-west-2.

sophia: saw it too. console change pushed a couple mins before. I pushed a per-org override that set burst_window_ms=0 for a small set of customers as part of the 'safety clamp' experiment.

mike: wait, 0 as a value — does our translation treat 0 as "no-burst" or "inherit"? I thought the schema said null -> inherit, 0 -> zero-length window (instant refill).

console-team: quick config excerpt (from the change):
```json
{"overrides": [{"org": "acme-corp", "burst_window_ms": 0, "burst_tokens": 500}], "ratefilter": {"enabled": true}}
```

eva: if burst_window_ms=0 -> burst token bucket resets every request, effectively allowing zero burst and making steady-state rate the only thing enforced. For clients that were relying on small bursts, they'll now get 429s.

aris: infra metrics -> 429s jumped from ~0.2% -> 18% for acme-corp between 09:12 and 09:24. Traces show many short-lived traffic spikes hitting per-key token exhaustion.

infra-oncall: running quick check on the translation service (rate-config-translator). `kubectl logs -n infra rate-config-translator-7f8b` shows:
```
INFO applied override for org=acme-corp burst_window_ms=0
WARN translated burst_window_ms=0 -> literal 0 in enforcement-layer
```

mike: that "literal 0" mapping is the problem — enforcement-layer expects null to mean "use org default" but zero is valid and means "no-burst". Our console UI allowed 0 and the change assumed it would mean unset.

sophia: ack. I'm going to roll the console change back and remove the 0 overrides. Can someone stage a rollback for the translator mapping?

deploy-bot: rollback triggered by @sophia — rolling console-change v2026.11.22-r2 -> v2026.11.21-stable. Estimated ETA 5m.

aris: diagnostic command: `curl -sS -H "x-org-id: acme-corp" https://enforcer.internal/metrics | jq '.rate_limit'` -> shows `"burst_window_ms":0` on many keys.

infra-oncall: temporary mitigation: enabling permissive-fallback in enforcer (policy: if burst_window_ms == 0 then treat as inherit) via hotfix flag. Patching now.

console-team: patch pushed to rate-config-translator: treat 0 as unset for overrides from console until we update the UI validation. PR #2745.

deploy-bot: hotfix applied to enforcer in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Rollback of console change completed.

aris: metrics update: 429s for acme-corp down to 0.8% 6m after rollback. Latency stable.

eva: temporary hotspot mitigation worked. Root cause: console allowed ambiguous value (0) and translation layer wrote literal 0 -> enforcement interpreted as strict no-burst.

mike: action items: 1) console: disallow 0 for burst_window_ms in per-org overrides (validation + UX hint). 2) translator: explicit sentinel for "unset" vs numeric. 3) enforcer: make permissive fallback behind a feature flag and log when fallback triggers. 4) add regression test in e2e for override translation.

sophia: agreed. I'll open follow-ups and assign owners.

eva: also recommend adding a short-lived alert for sudden rise in per-org 429 rate that ties to recent config changes (deploys/console edits) — would have flagged correlation faster.

aris: thanks team. postmortem ticket: PM-3110. I'll collect timelines and put a brief for oncall. :thumbsup:

mike: great catch.

infra-oncall: closing incident channel after we confirm no remaining spikes in next 30m.

aris: confirming no new alerts in the past 10m. closing for now.
